bio_en: Koriun, also called Iso or Isro, came from a wealthy family of the village of Goms near Mush and was educated at the St Karapet monastery school. Village headman at twenty, he became a Dashnak through Hrayr and his devoted disciple; he killed the traitor Karapet vardapet of Avranats, was jailed in Mush with a 101-year sentence, broke through the prison wall and escaped to Sasun. He fought alongside Gevorg Chavush, was the central figure in the fights of Norashen and Hunan, and distinguished himself as a leader in the 1904 Sasun uprising; he then organised a Kurdish committee in Bingol and personally killed a feared informer. In 1906 he crossed to the Caucasus, where he defended villages in Karabakh and Zangezur; one village saved by him was renamed Koriunavan.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Listed among the ARF's military victims (Droshak 1926); circumstances and year of death not given in the text read.
